messages:
maya: FYI I opened a PR to slim down the Quickstart into a true 3-step first-run for newbies. Goal: no global CLI install, minimal auth snippet, and a tiny Docker run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — please scan for auth var names and copy.
kevin: Nice. Can you paste the updated auth snippet here? The old one used REDWOOD_API_TOKEN vs API_TOKEN mismatch and folks keep hitting it. :eyes:
maya: ```bash
# set your trial key
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REPLACE_ME
# local run example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"hello-mini","input":"hi"}'
```
alex: CI flagged a lint issue on that block — missing language tag on fenced code blocks (we require ```bash). Also Netlify linkcheck shows a redirect loop on /getting-started/quickstart, not caused by your change but the PR will fail until I fix it.
olga: Suggestion: in the Docker snippet use `--env-file .env` instead of a long inline -e list; show a minimal .env example and mention trial keys expire after 24h. Lots of newbies paste keys into public repos otherwise. :warning:
maya: Good call. I'll switch to .env and add a one-line note about expiry and rotating keys. Also considering adding a short "no-account local" path with a tiny docker-compose that spins a dev server so they can try without provisioning. Need a reviewer for the UI copy and the extra step. cc @kevin
kevin: I'll review later today. Small nit: I think the canonical env var in SDK helpers is REDWOOD_API_KEY (not REDWOOD_TOKEN) — keep that consistent with SDK helpers across the repo.
maya: Updated the branch — renamed env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, swapped Docker to --env-file and added a .env.example in the snippet, plus a one-line warning about ephemeral keys. Also added a basic e2e doc test that starts the quickstart and checks a 200 on /health.
docs-bot: Build status: docs build — failed (link-check) 
  Details: 1 broken link: /getting-started/quickstart -> 404.
alex: I'm on the redirect fix for Netlify and will re-run linkcheck after I push. Might be an old alias interfering with the new path.
maya: Thanks — once CI is green can someone merge and backport to stable-1.0? We want this in the onboarding refresh next week.
olga: :shipit: I'll take the backport and also scan Dedicated docs for env var naming collisions before merging.
kevin: :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks all — will post a short release note blurb for the onboarding doc changelog after merge.
